CITY OF SAN MARINO

  NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the City staff of San Marino will be hosting a Town Hall
discussion to introduce the new trash haulers, Valley Vista Services and provide a general
overview of waste hauling services. City staff will also present information on proposed sewer
rates, including what’s being considered and how it will safeguard San Marino’s critical
infrastructure on Tuesday, June 10, 2025, commencing at 6:00 p.m. at 1800 Huntington
Drive, San Marino, California. It is intended that this will be a City staff run meeting and the
discussion will focus on the new trash haulers, Valley Vista Services, and proposed sewer rates.
However, due to the possibility that three (3) or more members of the San Marino City Council
may attend this meeting, notice of a special meeting of the San Marino City Council is hereby
given in an abundance of caution pursuant to Section 54956 of the Government Code of the
State of California.

  The Zoom link to watch this Town Hall from home can be found online at:
  www.SanMarinoCA.gov/TownHall

Dated: June 6, 2025  s/ Alison Walker
Published: June 6, 2025  Alison Walker, City Clerk
Notice No.: N-25-03  City of San Marino
